about: SHRINK game data, generated by software/slides/make_game_data.py in the SWELL project. Pixel coordinates are full-resolution slide pixels; sizes in micrometres are pixels x the scanner's pixel size (mpp).

butterfly-scales.intro_en: Scales brushed off a butterfly's wing.
butterfly-scales.intro_zh: 从蝴蝶翅膀上刷下来的鳞片。

castor-seed.intro_en: A castor bean cut across. (Castor beans are poisonous: never eat them.)
castor-seed.intro_zh: 蓖麻种子横切。（蓖麻籽有毒，千万别吃。）

corn-seed.intro_en: One corn kernel cut lengthwise: a baby plant and its food store.
corn-seed.intro_zh: 一粒玉米纵切：一株小苗和它的粮仓。

corn-stem.intro_en: A corn stem cut lengthwise, with long rows of cells.
corn-stem.intro_zh: 玉米茎纵切，细胞排成长长的一列列。

cotton.intro_en: Loose cotton fibres, the stuff of T-shirts.
cotton.intro_zh: 散开的棉纤维，做 T 恤的原料。

fern-leaf.en: Bracken fern leaf with spore cases, section
fern-leaf.intro_en: A slice across a bracken fern leaf with spore cases underneath.
fern-leaf.intro_zh: 蕨叶横切，叶子背面挂着孢子囊。

fish-gill.intro_en: A slice through a fish's gill, filaments lined up like a comb.
fish-gill.intro_zh: 鱼鳃切片，鳃丝像梳子齿一样排开。

fish-tail.intro_en: A slice across a fish's tail: muscle around a backbone.
fish-tail.intro_zh: 鱼尾横切：脊柱外面包着肌肉。

frog-embryo.en: Frog egg at the early gastrula stage, section
frog-embryo.intro_en: A frog egg cut in half, days after it was laid.
frog-embryo.intro_zh: 一颗产下几天的青蛙卵，切成两半。

honeybee-wing.intro_en: A whole back wing from a honeybee.

housefly-wing.intro_en: A whole wing from a house fly.

lily-anther.en: Lily anther, cross-section (the printed label wrongly reads 'Rotifera w.m.')
lily-anther.zh: 百合花药横切（标签误印为“轮虫装片”）
lily-anther.intro_en: A slice across a lily anther, full of pollen. (The printed label on this slide says something else; the tissue is an anther.)
lily-anther.intro_zh: 百合花药横切，里面全是花粉。（这张玻片印的标签写的是别的东西，但组织确实是花药。）

lily-ovary.intro_en: A slice across a lily flower's ovary, with three chambers.
lily-ovary.intro_zh: 百合花子房横切，有三个小房间。

lily-pollen.intro_en: Loose lily pollen grains spread on glass.
lily-pollen.intro_zh: 撒在玻片上的百合花粉粒。

liverwort.intro_en: A tiny umbrella from a liverwort, one of the simplest land plants.
liverwort.intro_zh: 地钱的一把小“伞”，地钱是最简单的陆地植物之一。

mosquito-wing.intro_en: A whole wing from a mosquito.

mushroom.zh: 伞菌（蘑菇）菌盖与菌褶切片
mushroom.intro_en: A slice across a mushroom cap: the stalk in the middle, gills all around.
mushroom.intro_zh: 蘑菇伞盖横切：中间是菌柄，周围是一片片菌褶。

mussel-gill.intro_en: A slice through a shellfish gill; its surface is lined with tiny beating hairs.
mussel-gill.intro_zh: 贝类的鳃切片，表面长着会摆动的细毛。

oleander-leaf.intro_en: A slice across an oleander leaf, built for dry places. (Oleander is poisonous: don't chew it.)
oleander-leaf.intro_zh: 夹竹桃叶横切，它是为干旱的地方长成的。（夹竹桃有毒，不要嚼。）

onion-root-tip.en: Onion root tip, lengthwise section, showing dividing cells
onion-root-tip.zh: 洋葱根尖纵切（示有丝分裂）
onion-root-tip.intro_en: Two onion root tips cut lengthwise. Hunt for cells that are dividing.
onion-root-tip.intro_zh: 两个洋葱根尖纵切。找一找正在分裂的细胞。

pancreas.intro_en: A slice of a dog's pancreas, which makes digestive juices and insulin.
pancreas.intro_zh: 狗胰腺切片，胰腺会做消化液和胰岛素。

pine-pollen-cone.en: Young male pine cone, lengthwise section
pine-pollen-cone.intro_en: A young male pine cone cut lengthwise; its pockets make pollen.
pine-pollen-cone.intro_zh: 松树幼小的雄球花纵切，那些小口袋会做花粉。

pine-stem.intro_en: A slice across a pine branch. Can you count its rings?
pine-stem.intro_zh: 松树枝横切。你能数出它有几圈年轮吗？

pumpkin-stem.intro_en: A slice across a pumpkin vine. The big holes are water pipes.
pumpkin-stem.intro_zh: 南瓜藤横着切的一片。大洞是输水管。

root.en: Root of a land plant, cross-section
root.intro_en: A slice across a root, with a star of water pipes in the middle.
root.intro_zh: 一条根横切，中间是星形排列的输水管。

root-tip.intro_en: A root tip cut lengthwise, from its cap upwards.
root-tip.intro_zh: 一个根尖纵切，从根冠往上看。

roundworm.intro_en: A slice across a large roundworm (Ascaris).

shoot-tip.intro_en: The growing tip of a shoot cut lengthwise, wrapped in baby leaves.
shoot-tip.intro_zh: 嫩枝生长点纵切，外面包着一层层新叶。

sunflower-stem.intro_en: A slice across a sunflower stem, with its ring of pipe bundles.
sunflower-stem.intro_zh: 向日葵茎横切，里面有一圈管束。

tomato.intro_en: A whole slice of a small tomato, seeds and all.
tomato.intro_zh: 一个小番茄的整片切片，连籽一起。

tree-stem.en: Woody stem of a broad-leaved plant, cross-section
tree-stem.zh: 木本双子叶植物茎横切
tree-stem.intro_en: A slice across a young woody stem: bark outside, wood inside, soft pith in the middle.
tree-stem.intro_zh: 一根年轻木质茎的横切：外面是树皮，里面是木头，正中是软软的髓。

expeditions.intro_en: Four insects, four tricks for flying.
expeditions.intro_zh: 四种昆虫，四种飞行的诀窍。

expeditions.intro_en: From the tip of a root to a leaf: the road water takes through a plant.
expeditions.intro_zh: 从根尖到叶子：水在植物里走的路。

expeditions.intro_en: Pollen, ovules, seeds and baby plants.
Catch cells in the middle of dividing.
Fish, worms and what is inside them.
expeditions.intro_zh: 鱼、虫子，还有它们身体里面。

expeditions.intro_en: A catapult, a spore factory, tree rings and the secret of your T-shirt.
expeditions.intro_zh: 弹射器、孢子工厂、年轮，还有你 T 恤的秘密。

bee-hooks.fact_en: A honeybee has two wings on each side. In flight, this row of tiny hooks on the back wing catches the edge of the front wing, so the two flap as one big wing.
bee-hooks.fact_zh: 蜜蜂每边有两片翅膀。飞的时候，后翅上这一排小钩子会钩住前翅的边，两片翅膀就像一整片那样一起扇动。

fly-spines.fact_en: The thick front vein of a fly's wing is lined with stiff spines, and the rest of the wing is covered in tiny hairs.
fly-spines.fact_zh: 苍蝇翅膀最前面那条粗翅脉上长着一排硬刺，翅膀其余的地方盖满了细毛。

mosquito-scales.fact_en: Like butterflies, mosquitoes have tiny scales on their wings, lined up along the veins and the edges. The whine you hear comes from their wings beating very fast.
mosquito-scales.fact_zh: 和蝴蝶一样，蚊子的翅膀上也有小鳞片，沿着翅脉和翅缘排成一排。你听到的嗡嗡声，是它们的翅膀飞快扇动发出来的。

butterfly-scale.fact_en: Butterfly wings are covered in tiny overlapping scales, like roof tiles. Look closely: fine ridges run along each one. Some colours come from pigment and some from ridges like these bending light. Butterflies and moths are called Lepidoptera, which means 'scale wings'.
butterfly-scale.fact_zh: 蝴蝶的翅膀上盖满了一片压一片的小鳞片，像屋顶的瓦。仔细看，每片鳞片上都有一道道细细的纵棱。有些颜色来自色素，有些来自这样的细棱把光折出来。蝴蝶和蛾子的学名叫 Lepidoptera，意思就是“鳞翅”。

root-cap.fact_en: The tip of every root wears a cap of loose cells that protects it as it pushes through soil. The outer cells rub off and new ones replace them. Cells in the cap also sense gravity, so the root knows which way is down.
root-cap.fact_zh: 每条根的尖端都戴着一顶由松散细胞组成的“帽子”，在根往土里钻的时候保护它。外层的细胞会被磨掉，新的细胞再补上。帽子里的细胞还能感觉重力，让根知道哪边是下。

root-pipes.fact_en: The big round holes are pipes made from dead, hollow cells joined end to end. They carry water and minerals up from the root to the leaves.
root-pipes.fact_zh: 这些大圆洞是管子，由死去的、空心的细胞一个接一个连成。它们把水和矿物质从根一路运到叶子。

pumpkin-pipes.sci_en: xylem vessels in a vascular bundle
pumpkin-pipes.fact_en: Climbing plants like pumpkins move a lot of water a long way to their big leaves and fruit, so their stems have extra-wide water pipes.
pumpkin-pipes.fact_zh: 南瓜这样的藤本植物要把大量的水送到很远的大叶子和果实里，所以它们的茎里有特别粗的输水管。

sunflower-bundle.fact_en: A sunflower stem has a ring of bundles like this one. Each holds two kinds of pipe: xylem carries water up, and phloem carries sugar from the leaves to the rest of the plant.
sunflower-bundle.fact_zh: 向日葵的茎里有一圈这样的“管束”。每一束里有两种管子：木质部把水往上运，韧皮部把叶子做出来的糖送到植物的其他地方。

oleander-pit.fact_en: Oleander grows in dry, sunny places. Its breathing holes (stomata) sit at the bottom of pits lined with hairs, which hold moist air in so the leaf loses less water.
oleander-pit.fact_zh: 夹竹桃长在又干又晒的地方。它的呼吸孔（气孔）藏在长满毛的小坑底部，毛能留住湿润的空气，让叶子少丢一些水。

lily-pollen-grains.fact_en: An anther is the part of a flower that makes pollen. Each grain carries cells that can travel to another flower and help make a seed. Look at a grain's edge: its shell has a net-like pattern.
lily-pollen-grains.fact_zh: 花药是花里专门做花粉的地方。每一粒花粉都带着细胞，可以到另一朵花上去，帮忙结出种子。看看花粉粒的边：它的外壳上有网一样的花纹。

lily-ovules.fact_en: Inside a lily's ovary, ovules sit in three chambers. When pollen lands on the flower, it grows a long tube down to an ovule, and the ovule can then become a seed.
lily-ovules.fact_zh: 百合的子房分成三个小房间，胚珠就待在里面。花粉落到花上以后，会长出一根长长的管子一直伸到胚珠，胚珠这才能变成种子。

tomato-seed.fact_en: Every tomato seed sits in jelly. Inside its coat a baby plant lies curled up, waiting for water and warmth to start growing.
tomato-seed.fact_zh: 每一粒番茄籽都泡在果冻一样的东西里。在种皮里面，一株小苗蜷着身子，等着水和温暖来了再开始长。

corn-baby-shoot.en: A baby plant in a kernel
corn-baby-shoot.sci_en: embryo: the young shoot in its sheath
corn-baby-shoot.fact_en: Every corn kernel holds a tiny plant with a shoot and a root, next to a big store of starch to live on until it can make its own food. In popcorn, that starch and a little water inside it are what pop.
corn-baby-shoot.fact_zh: 每一粒玉米里都藏着一株带芽和根的小植物，旁边是一大块淀粉，够它吃到自己能制造养分为止。爆米花之所以会爆，靠的就是这块淀粉和里面的一点点水。

shoot-baby-leaves.fact_en: At the very tip of a growing shoot, new leaves start as tiny bumps and curl around the tip to protect it. Every leaf on a plant began like this.
shoot-baby-leaves.fact_zh: 在正在长的嫩枝最尖端，新叶一开始只是一个个小鼓包，它们弯过来把尖端包住、保护起来。植物身上的每一片叶子都是这样开始的。

onion-prophase.fact_en: This cell is about to divide. Its chromosomes, the cell's instruction books (already copied), are coiling up into thick threads you can see as squiggles.
onion-prophase.fact_zh: 这个细胞马上要分裂了。它的染色体，也就是细胞的“说明书”（已经复制好了一份），正盘绕成粗粗的线，你看到的弯弯曲曲就是它们。

onion-anaphase.sci_zh: 有丝分裂：染色体被拉开
onion-anaphase.fact_en: The two dark bands are two sets of chromosomes, pulled to opposite ends of the cell. Soon a new wall grows across the middle and one cell becomes two. A growing root tip does this again and again.
onion-anaphase.fact_zh: 这两条深色的带子是两套染色体，被拉到了细胞的两头。很快，中间会长出一道新的墙，一个细胞就变成两个。正在长的根尖一遍又一遍地这样做。

frog-yolk-cells.sci_en: yolk-filled cells of an early embryo
frog-yolk-cells.sci_zh: 早期胚胎里富含卵黄的细胞
frog-yolk-cells.fact_en: This frog egg has already divided into a great many cells. These big ones are stuffed with grains of yolk, the food that keeps the embryo growing until it becomes a tadpole that can feed itself.
frog-yolk-cells.fact_zh: 这颗青蛙卵已经分裂成了很多很多个细胞。这些大个的细胞里塞满了卵黄颗粒，那是胚胎的食物，一直够它长到变成能自己找吃的蝌蚪。

gill-plates.fact_en: A fish breathes by passing water over its gills. Each gill filament is lined with thin plates where blood flows very close to the water and picks up oxygen. The dark dots are red blood cells: unlike yours, a fish's red blood cells keep their nucleus.
gill-plates.fact_zh: 鱼靠让水流过鳃来呼吸。每根鳃丝上排满了薄薄的小片，血液在里面贴着水流过，把氧气接过来。那些深色的小点是红细胞：和你的不一样，鱼的红细胞里还留着细胞核。

fish-notochord.fact_en: This ring is one bone of the fish's backbone, and in its middle sits a rod of balloon-like cells called the notochord. Every animal with a backbone has a notochord as an embryo, including you; parts of yours live on in the soft centres of the discs in your back.
fish-notochord.fact_zh: 这个圆环是鱼脊柱里的一节骨头，中间是一根由气球一样的细胞组成的棒，叫脊索。所有有脊柱的动物在胚胎时期都有脊索，你也有过；它的一部分现在还留在你背上椎间盘柔软的中心里。

worm-gut-fold.fact_en: An earthworm eats soil and digests the bits of dead plants in it. A deep fold along the top of its gut gives it more surface to soak up food.
worm-gut-fold.fact_zh: 蚯蚓吃土，消化土里那些枯死植物的碎屑。它肠子顶上有一道深深的褶，让肠子有更多的面积来吸收养分。

roundworm-eggs.sci_en: eggs in the uterus of a large roundworm
roundworm-eggs.fact_en: Each oval is an egg with a tough shell. These worms live in the guts of pigs and people, one good reason to wash your hands.
roundworm-eggs.fact_zh: 每一个椭圆都是一个外壳很硬的卵。这种虫住在猪和人的肠子里，这正是要勤洗手的一个好理由。

fern-catapult.fact_en: Ferns have no flowers or seeds. Under their leaves, tiny cases like this hold spores. A ring of thick-walled cells around the case dries out, pulls it open, then snaps back and flings the spores into the air.
fern-catapult.fact_zh: 蕨类没有花，也没有种子。它们叶子背面有这样的小囊，里面装着孢子。囊外面一圈厚壁细胞变干时会把囊扯开，然后猛地弹回去，把孢子甩到空中。

mushroom-spores.fact_en: Under a mushroom cap, thin gills hang down like the pages of a book. Their surfaces are lined with cells that each make spores, and one mushroom can release a great many of them.
mushroom-spores.fact_zh: 蘑菇伞盖下面，薄薄的菌褶像书页一样垂下来。菌褶表面排满了会造孢子的细胞，一个蘑菇能放出非常多的孢子。

pine-rings.fact_en: Each band of wood is one year's growth: big, pale cells grow in spring and small, thick-walled ones in late summer. Count the bands to find how old this branch was.
pine-rings.fact_zh: 每一圈木头是一年长出来的：春天长出大个、颜色浅的细胞，夏末长出小个、壁厚的细胞。数一数有几圈，就知道这根树枝有几岁。

cotton-ribbon.fact_en: Each cotton fibre is a single long cell that grew out of a cotton seed. When it dries it flattens into a twisted ribbon, and the twists help fibres grip each other when they are spun into thread for your T-shirt.
cotton-ribbon.fact_zh: 每一根棉纤维都是从棉籽上长出来的一个长长的细胞。它干了以后会变扁、拧成一条扭曲的带子，这些扭曲让纤维在纺成线时能互相咬住，最后变成你的 T 恤。

buddies.source: Wikipedia, 'Hair' (web page, read 2026-10-11): human hair diameter varies from 0.017 to 0.18 mm; typical ranges by ancestry 60–120 µm
Wikipedia, 'House dust mite' (web page, read 2026-10-11): a typical house dust mite measures 0.2–0.3 mm in length

buddies.en: one of your red blood cells
buddies.source: Wikipedia, 'Red blood cell' (web page, read 2026-10-11): a typical human red blood cell has a disk diameter of approximately 6.2–8.2 µm
Wikipedia, 'Escherichia coli' (web page, read 2026-10-11): cells are about 2.0 µm long and 0.25–1.0 µm in diameter
Wikipedia, 'Black garden ant' (web page, read 2026-10-11): workers are 3–5 mm long
Wikipedia, 'Cat flea' (web page, read 2026-10-11): adults of both sexes range from 1–2 mm long
